exposure: Disability status (physical, intellectual, sensory, or none)
outcome: Obstetric interventions (oxytocin augmentation, operative vaginal delivery, cesarean delivery)
cohort: 223,385 women who delivered between January 2002 and January 2008, from the Consortium on Safe Labor database
finding: Women with disabilities had a higher risk of adverse maternal outcomes, including severe maternal morbidities and mortality, as well as a higher risk of obstetric interventions, compared to women without disabilities.
